summary_1line: Hiranyavarman learns Sikhandin is female, prepares war against Drupada, while Drupada and his queen admit the deception and pray to avert conflict.

image_candidates.scene_text: A furious King Hiranyavarman hears the nurses' report that Sikhandin is a woman and rises in rage before his assembled court.
King Drupada, pale with fear, confers privately with his queen about their daughter Sikhandin as news of an approaching army spreads.
Drupada and his queen perform solemn worship before sacred fire and idols, praying the gods will prevent a war with Hiranyavarman.
